mentions.name: USCodex
mentions.description: This platform collects all US federal law in version control and cross-links references between different sections. It currently includes the US Code, the CFR, roughly 30 years of public laws and congressional bills, and 25 years of executive orders, stored in raw git repos as the main data store, which compresses well and makes it easy to generate diffs of individual sections.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building https://uscodex.org. In a nutshell, the goal is to collect all US federal law in version control, and cross-link any references between different sections. Currently I have the US Code, CFR, ~30 years of public laws and congressional bills and 25 years of executive orders.
mentions.author: SebRollen
